key_findings: [uncertain] Ting-Chia Hsu is a Distinguished Professor at National Taiwan Normal University (NTNU) in the Department of Technology Application and Human Resource Development. Primary research focuses on technology-enhanced learning, AI literacy, and computational thinking education. Some peripheral work on AI ethics in academic writing (PRISMA bibliometric analysis of 267 Scopus-indexed publications on AI-infused academic writing 2022-2026). how_it_changes_the_analysis: If Ting-Chia Hsu has published direct research on academic integrity in Asian/Taiwanese contexts: Would add voice of major East Asian educational technology researcher to non-Western integrity scholarship.
